research_notes: Name/identity: PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk (unchanged in all documents FY2019-9M2026), Bandung Barat, West Java. Controlling shareholder Sabana Prawirawidjaja (53.17%) with PT Prawirawidjaja Prakarsa (23.78%) and family members; public 13.99% (shareholder register of 17 Sep 2026 in the rights-issue disclosure of 18 Sep 2026, Keterbukaan_Informasi_ULTJ_ENG.pdf PDF p. 9). Dairy (UHT milk) and tea (Teh Kotak) maker; subsector household_dairy.
Currency/units: IDR reporter; FS in Rp juta, all money stored in IDR billion (Rp juta / 1,000). Auditor: KAP Tanubrata Sutanto Fahmi Bambang & Rekan (BDO) for every year.

Source policy: each FY's own audited consolidated FS (ultrajaya.co.id 'Annual Financial Report Audited'). Many primary-statement pages in these PDFs are signed scans without a text layer (FS2021 balance sheet and P&L, FS2022 balance sheet and B/2, FS2023 P&L, FS2024 A/3 and B/2, FS2025 balance sheet and P&L); those values were read from page renders and cross-checked against the text-layer comparatives in the following year's FS (FS2022 p. 7, FS2023 p. 4-6, FS2024 p. 7, FS9M2026 p. 5-7) and the AR2025 highlights (p. 9-10) - all agree except the re-presentations noted on FY2023 operating profit and CFO and the FY2019 revenue reclassification.

FY2019 base levels come from the FS2020 comparative column (text layer); FS2019's own statements are scanned. Only revenue differs from the original (6,241,419 originally vs 6,223,057 after FS2020 moved the 18,362 performance bonus out of sales).

Corporate actions 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-04: none (no split, reverse split, bonus or rights issue). Share-listing chronology (AR2025 PDF p. 50): IPO 1990, share dividend 1992, rights I 1994, bonus 1995, rights II 1999, split 1:5 Jan 2001, rights III Apr 2004, split 1:4 26 Jun 2017, then only the 24 Aug 2023 cancellation of treasury shares. corporate_actions is therefore empty and fy.2019.year_end_price is not needed.

Share buyback and capital reduction (not splits; no per-share adjustment): 1,155,352,800 shares (10%) bought back 25 Jun-5 Aug 2020 at Rp1,600 for Rp1,854.4 bn incl. costs (FS2020 Note 26), funded by the Rp3 tn MTN issued Nov 2020; cancelled by capital reduction approved by the EGMS of 19 Jun 2023, effective with MoLHR approval AHU-0049934.AH.01.02 of 24 Aug 2023 (issued shares 11,553,528,000 -> 10,398,175,200). Shares outstanding have been 10,398,175,200 since Aug 2020. Buyback plans disclosed 21 Mar 2025 (up to 10%, Rp1.67 tn budget) and Jun 2025 were not executed (no treasury shares in FS2025 / FS9M2026).

PENDING (not a corporate action yet): 'PMHMETD IV' rights issue of up to 7,878,669,985 new shares at Rp2,150 (about 0.758 rights per existing share; disclosure of 18 Sep 2026, https://www.ultrajaya.co.id/uploads/Keterbukaan_Informasi_ULTJ_ENG.pdf PDF p. 5-10). The controlling holders' rights are to be transferred to FrieslandCampina International Holding B.V. (FCIH), Blue Waves Group Ventures and PT Bahtera Wiraniaga Internusa, who pay in kind (inbreng) with 100% of PT Frisian Flag Indonesia (contribution value Rp14,569,997 mn; appraised market value Rp14,570,193 mn at 31 Jul 2026, PDF p. 23); 6,776,742,153 new shares go to them and FCIH becomes the controlling shareholder (28.95-30.81%) with a mandatory tender offer to follow. The EGMS was moved from 27 Oct to 6 Nov 2026 after OJK letter S-370/PM.212/2026 asked for more information (announcement of 23 Oct 2026, https://www.ultrajaya.co.id/uploads/20261023_Pengumuman_Perubahan_Jadwal_RUPSLB.pdf); after approval the registration statement must still become effective. When it goes ex, add a 'rights' record (ratio from the prospectus, price 2150) and expect FFI to be consolidated (series break).

Dividends: one final cash dividend a year out of each FY's profit, no interims; dates from the AGMS summaries (ringkasan risalah) published on ultrajaya.co.id (FY2023 and FY2024 summaries are scanned notary documents, read from renders). AGMS were held late in 2020-2022 (Aug 2020, Aug 2021, Jul 2022). The company states payout as a % of consolidated profit for the year INCLUDING non-controlling interest; payout_ratio stores that figure as printed (approximate, e.g. 'sekitar 32%'). FY2025 payout ~98% (Rp130/share) is a step-up from 20-41% in FY2021-FY2024.

EBITDA: reported only in the annual Public Expose decks (definition: earning before interest, tax, depreciation, amortization). FY2020-FY2021 are exact (IDR million tables, Dec 2022 deck); FY2022-FY2025 are chart values in IDR bn. FY2020 conflicts between decks (Dec 2021: 1,529,646; Dec 2022: 1,552,978 IDR million) - the later one is stored. AR highlight tables give only EBITDA coverage ratios.

Liquidity: large holdings of government bonds/FVOCI investments sat outside 'cash' in 2019-2022 (e.g. 2,346.8 bn current + 660.6 bn non-current at end-2020, 1,838.5 bn end-2021, 828.4 bn end-2022). total_debt excludes lease payables and, in FY2019-FY2020, the small liability for purchases of machinery (supplier loan: 30.1 bn end-2019, 11.0 bn end-2020).

Validation: eps_shares:2020 is a real gap (reported EPS uses the 11,048,942,070 weighted-average shares of the buyback year; see validation_ack). AR2023's share-price table (PDF p. 11) wrongly repeats the 2022 rows for 2023; the 2023 close 1,600 comes from AR2024 p. 12 and the AR2023 p. 45 chart label. No ULTJ daily price file existed in the dataset yet to cross-check year-end closes.

9M2026: net sales +31.1% and attributable profit +48.9% YoY (FS9M2026). The FS does not explain the jump; the Mar 2026 Public Expose deck (p. 22) shows direct school-milk sales for the government's free-meal programme (MBG) starting Jul 2025 (2.1% of Dec 2025 sales) and a new MM2100 plant (p. 23). Reviewer: treat the YoY growth as real (both columns from the same unaudited FS, prior column equal to the 9M2025 FS as published).
